verdict.rationale: Ente Auth syncs codes through a self-hostable server, so a published API spec is a fair thing to ask for. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and no docs mention an API spec. The documented JSON structure of the encrypted export describes a data format, not an API, and llms.txt is a documentation index; both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
